versions.changelog:
- Added license field to metadata (MIT).
- Expanded description to clarify code generation, authentication methods, and endpoint coverage.
- Improved documentation on finding endpoints, method names, and generated types.
- Refined security section and reworded "Security and safety" to "Security & safety".
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md file.

Initial release of go-lovable – an unofficial Go client for the Lovable API.

- Provides typed access to Lovable projects, publishing, deployments, embed URLs, analytics, security scans, workspaces, groups, and members.
- Requires Go toolchain and LOVABLE_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Guides safe usage: never log credentials, treat embed URLs as sensitive, and perform write actions only at user request.
- Includes detailed usage instructions for installing, authenticating, and handling common API patterns.
- Only manages Go project source; does not read/write files outside code edits.
- Supports user-invocable operations for Go projects already importing the client.
